title: Guangdong agricultural resilience
description: A 2026–2050 scenario demonstration linking multi-hazard sequences, dynamic resilience, recovery margins and agricultural losses. Matched replays compare intervention timing under four economic pathways; the model is not yet calibrated.

title: AgriKB
description: A local agricultural decision-support prototype with China and Toulouse editions. The Web GUI and FastAPI backend combine regional crop context, market information, knowledge retrieval and advisory Q&A.

title: X-IMS maintenance optimization
description: Research code for interpretable maintenance optimization, with a browser sandbox and Python plug-in. The illustrative interface compares deferral, inspection, preventive maintenance and replacement under explicit health and cost assumptions.

title: X-IMS maintenance-impact identification
description: Notebooks and Python workflows for interpretable maintenance-impact identification. A standalone browser explorer compares signals before and after maintenance and reports effect sizes and trajectory changes.

title: RFEMNN rotor diagnostics
description: Curated reproduction code for the rotor-dynamics-informed model reported in Advanced Engineering Informatics.

title: PG-SpecMoE
description: Physics-guided spectral mixture-of-experts for gearbox and bearing diagnosis across operating conditions. The archive includes experiment scripts, figure sources and selected results, with separate source-only and target-adaptation evaluation tracks.

title: Spectral evidence coordination
description: Source and frozen revision evidence for information-bounded cross-speed gearbox diagnosis. The repository records predictions, protocol checks, statistics and figure regeneration for manuscript AME-26-0411.

title: PIML benchmark architecture
description: Code accompanying the battery RUL framework and its associated benchmark architecture.

title: Physics-informed TCN
description: A lightweight temporal convolution implementation for physics-informed bearing prognostics.

title: IGBT transient inverse PINN
description: A transient physics-informed neural model for reconstructing three-dimensional temperature fields from surface measurements while identifying solder thermal conductivity in IGBT power modules.

title: O-M-Flow
description: Ontology-constrained retrieval for aviation fault diagnosis. Structured fault evidence, graph propagation, evidence fusion and reranking connect source documents with diagnostic questions; code and aggregate evaluation results are provided.

title: AeroKG
description: An offline engineering knowledge-system prototype combining industrial ontology, knowledge graphs, retrieval-augmented generation and evidence traceability for aviation airworthiness and maintenance workflows.

title: AeroMech Research Assistant
description: The AI4S repository provides a research assistant for aerospace mechatronics, PHM and physics-informed learning. It connects research metadata, journal comparison, evidence ledgers and reproducible research-package scaffolds.

title: Machinery PHM tutorial
description: A practical collection of notebooks and examples for machinery prognostics and health management.
